Name: (fs) mia's ears 2 for fashion sense
Author: eltolinde
Description:
[right][size=5][b]you need[/b][/size][/right]
[right][size=3][url=https://smapi.io][b]smapi[/b][/url] ver. 4.5.2 or newest[/size][/right]
[right][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969][b]fashion sense[/b][/url] ver. 7.5.0 or later[/size][/right]

[size=6][b]description[/b][/size]
[size=3]this mod adds 19 non-animated, skin hued*, fashion sense-implemented accessories.[/size]

[size=3]*cosmetics that, alternatively, read from custom rgb ranges are suffixed with '(palette)'.[/size]

[size=3]unless a fashion sense-controlled body overlay is equipped, [color=#F9E6CF][b]your item's brightness slider must be set to 100 for the pictured results[/b][/color]. this rule does not apply to any aforementioned custom-rgb accessory.[/size]

[size=5][b]compatibility with other mods[/b][/size]
[size=3]the art was sprited with the [color=#F9E6CF][b]vanilla farmer's head, hair and face positions[/b][/color] in mind. as such, [b][color=#BFE271]add-ons that were not similarly plotted out may make foreign visuals 'clip' or look misplaced[/color][/b]. this isn't something i - or any other author - can effectively mitigate across all variations. the onus is entirely on the user to prevent these conflicts in their own loadouts.[/size]

[size=3]see the framework's documentation for manually [url=https://github.com/Floogen/FashionSense/wiki/Creating-an-Accessory-Content-Pack#basic-json-example][b]editing coordinate values[/b][/url] and [url=https://github.com/Floogen/FashionSense/wiki/DrawOrderOverride-Property][b]rearranging per-item draw order[/b][/url], as well as the permissions and credits drop-down for information regarding the distribution of modified files.[/size]

[size=5][b]suggested[/b][/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7764][b]ethnic skin tones[/b][/url] by Echobolide[/size]
[size=3]or...[/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18394][b]more skin tone options[/b][/url] by sneakyham[/size]
[size=3]or...[/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16370][b]darling skintones[/b][/url] by cherrybeefarm[/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23740][b]fs - player height variety[/b][/url] by PeacefulEnd[/size]

[center][size=3][color=#cccccc]has the hypothetical capacity to work on some versions of stardew valley 1.5.[/color][/size][/center]

Manifest.Name: Mia's Ears 2
Manifest.Description: Adds some fantastical ear accessories via PeacefulEnd's Fashion Sense framework.
Manifest.Author: mia
